First, note the given date: 09-05-1239 means May 9, 1239 (DD-MM-YYYY format).  
Subtract 48 weeks and 2 days = 48×7 + 2 = 338 days.  

1239 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1239 not divisible by 4).  
Subtract 338 days from May 9, 1239:  

Go back 9 days to April 30, 1239 → 9 days subtracted, 329 left.  
April has 30 days, go back 30 days to March 31 → 39 days subtracted, 299 left.  
March has 31 days, go back 31 days to February 28 (1239 not leap) → 70 days subtracted, 268 left.  
Continue: January has 31 days, go back 31 days to December 31, 1238 → 101 days subtracted, 237 left.  

Now in 1238 (leap year? 1238 not divisible by 4, so not leap).  
December has 31 days, go back 31 days to November 30 → 132 days subtracted, 206 left.  
November 30 days → back to October 31: 162 days subtracted, 176 left.  
October 31 days → back to September 30: 193 days subtracted, 145 left.  
September 30 days → back to August 31: 223 days subtracted, 115 left.  
August 31 days → back to July 31: 254 days subtracted, 84 left.  
July 31 days → back to June 30: 285 days subtracted, 53 left.  
June 30 days → back to May 31: 315 days subtracted, 23 left.  
From May 31, 1238, subtract 23 days:  
May has 31 days, so May 31 → May 8 = 23 days back.  

Thus new date = May 8, 1238.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1238-05-08
